title: My television showed my living room 📺
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:58 in the morning my television turned on and showed my living room.

scenes.narration: At 2:58 in the morning my television turned on and showed my living room.
Not a film. Not a channel. A camera view, from high in the corner. My sofa. My blanket. And me, standing in the doorway, watching the screen.
But I was in the hallway. I was not in the living room doorway. Not yet.
On the screen, the figure raised one hand. I was holding the remote in mine. I had not moved.
I pressed standby. Nothing. The screen showed me pressing it, a full second before I did.
The figure on the screen began to walk. Away from the doorway, toward the camera. Toward the hallway. Toward me. And the air behind me went very quiet.

The picture shook. The camera was not in the corner anymore. It was in someone's hand, moving along the hall, right behind my shoulder. And the last thing the television showed me was the back of my own head.
So tell me. Do you turn around, or unplug it?
